claims.statement: Determine whether a PIFB2-type continuum action on belief, model, and frame sections can be made mathematically rigorous under explicit hypotheses, while its live-peer KL sector remains generically distinct from the ordinary state-level ELBO of one fixed normalized joint; determine the resulting role of the exact ELBO theory.
claims.quantifiers: For every finite agent cover and every admissible section configuration satisfying the frozen analytic hypotheses, require a well-defined gauge-covariant action; do not require that every live-peer configuration family be representable by one fixed state-level joint on the original variables.
claims.falsifier: Either exhibit an admissible failure of the corrected action theorem or construct one fixed state-level joint that reproduces arbitrary moving-peer fields within the frozen no-go scope.
